name: TIMELESS
source:
TIMELESS is a kinetic novel about a antisocial genius scientist that discovered the solution (or not?) to aging, almost dying in the process, sleeping for many years into the future where everyone disappeared, except his monstrous (maybe cute) creations.

Will he remember his humanity, or will he die cold and alone as his nihilistic mind predicted?

[From [url=https://drmoonbad.itch.io/timeless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《TIMELESS》是一部无选项视觉小说，讲述一位不善与人交往的天才科学家的故事。他发现了解决衰老的办法，或许并没有？在险些因此丧命后，他沉睡多年，醒来时已身处遥远的未来。所有人都消失了，只剩下他那些怪物般的造物，或许它们也有点可爱。

他能重新找回人性，还是会如自己那虚无主义的头脑所预料的那样，孤独而冰冷地死去？

[摘自[url=https://drmoonbad.itch.io/timeless]Itch.io[/url]]
